ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels across central lobe surfaces versus 25% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels localized along the perimeter and central peduncle.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity central region bounded by a thick, irregular low-intensity perimeter. Distinct features include a small circular low-intensity spot in the upper-mid right lobe, a jagged low-intensity marking in the lower-mid left lobe, and a large concentrated low-intensity mass at the central base (peduncle junction).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with an approximate vertex angle of 55 degrees, transitioning into a high-contrast dark border.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and jagged topography. Right lobe exhibits three distinct deep semi-circular indentations. Left lobe shows continuous fine-grain serration with coarse pixel-amplitude variations across the entire trailing boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex lower edges tapering into sharply upward-curved terminal tips (flukes-up position).

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, high-intensity clusters of circular nodes consistent with acorn barnacle colonization localized specifically on the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical low-intensity linear marks visible in the lower interior quadrant of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant jagged notch/tissue indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe, approximately one-third of the distance from the tip toward the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique isolated dark focal point (spot) located in the upper interior region of the right lobe, distinct from edge pigmentation.
